description:
About the job

About Kennedy University

Kennedy University of Leadership, is an innovative, fast paced, global online university, based in the United States. The university has staff and students around the world, with a passion for applied, relevant career enhancing education.




Role overview

Department: Marketing

Reports to: Head of Marketing in Los Angeles

Location: Mexico City, remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: USD $2,500/month




This role sits inside the Kennedy University marketing department. You will work directly with the marketing team to produce content across social media, video, email, graphic design, and our website.

This is a creative execution role for someone who does not wait to be told. You will bring ideas, spot gaps, and push the work further than the brief asked for. You move fast, stay on-brand, and treat every asset, whether it is a 30-second reel or a brochure with brand integrity. 




English language and communications skills must be excellent and are essential.




What you will be doing

Video and content creation

- Editing short-form video content - 30-second cuts, social reels, and student story features

- Filming and interviewing students via Zoom, capturing story content for video and social - up to 10 sessions per week

- Adding logo overlays and motion treatments to video content

- Producing video assets that are polished, on-brand, and ready to publish

Graphic design and marketing collateral

- Designing flyers, brochures, social posts, email headers, and promotional materials in Canva

- Using Canva AI features to accelerate production without sacrificing quality

- Maintaining strict brand guideline accuracy across every asset

- Supporting the marketing team with design requests across campaigns and student communications

Email marketing

- Building and sending HTML email campaigns via HubSpot Marketing Suite

- Designing email templates that are clean, responsive, and on-brand

- Managing campaign scheduling and basic performance tracking

Social media

- Managing and scheduling content across Ducere social media platforms

- Supporting marketing campaign launches with creative assets and copy

- Monitoring engagement and flagging content opportunities to the team

Website

- Making content updates and edits to the Ducere website via WordPress

- Uploading assets, updating pages, and keeping content current and accurate

- Basic layout adjustments and formatting within the CMS




What we are looking for

Must have

- Solid video editing skills - short-form, social-first content

- Confident with Canva, including AI-assisted features

- Graphic design skills - flyers, brochures, and digital collateral

- Experience with HubSpot or a comparable email marketing platform

- Working knowledge of HTML for email templates

- Comfortable working in WordPress - editing pages and uploading content

- Strong attention to detail - brand accuracy is non-negotiable

- A proactive self-starter who brings creative ideas without being prompted

- Confident on camera and comfortable interviewing people via Zoom

- Clear communicator in English and Spanish

- Analytical mindset - you look at what is working and act on it

Nice to have

Experience with motion graphics or logo animation
Social media analytics and reporting
Prior experience at an education, or media brand
AI Tools and Automation experience

description:
About the job

Marketing Recruiter (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary: $800 to $1,300 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.




The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.




You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.




We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.




You should genuinely enjoy talking to people, evaluating talent, improving recruiting systems, and building relationships with candidates. You care about quality over quantity and believe that hiring one outstanding person beats hiring 10 average ones.




As our company grows, you'll also help improve our recruiting systems, employer branding, onboarding experience, company culture and talent pipelines so hiring becomes faster, smarter, and more scalable.




What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.




Day to day, that means you:

Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.
Present hiring managers with highly qualified candidates instead of large numbers of average applicants.
Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.
Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.
Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.
Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.
Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.
Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.
Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.
Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.
Partner closely with leadership to understand hiring priorities and proactively recommend improvements.




What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:




Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

Lifecycle Marketing: Email Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing Managers

Sales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals




As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.
Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.
Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.
Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.
Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.
Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.
Conduct structured interviews.
Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.
Perform reference checks when appropriate.
Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.
Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.




2) Candidate Evaluation

Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.
Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.
Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.
Build structured interview scorecards for every role.
Develop role-specific interview questions.
Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.




3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

Build and improve recruiting workflows.
Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.
Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.
Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.
Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.
Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.




4) Partnership With Leadership

Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.
Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.
Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.
Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.
Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.




5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.
Write engaging candidate outreach messages.
Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.
Help strengthen TopFoxx's reputation as an employer of choice.




6) Onboarding Support

Coordinate onboarding logistics for new hires.
Ensure candidates receive the information, tools, and documentation needed before their first day.
Partner with hiring managers to help new hires transition successfully into their roles.




7) Additional Support & Cross-Functional Projects

When recruiting needs are lighter, or as business needs evolve, you may also support other areas of the company based on your skills and priorities. This may include:

Supporting HR and administrative tasks when needed.
Helping organize company documents, processes, and SOPs.
Supporting project management and cross-functional projects when additional help is needed.
Helping with company culture, team engagement, and employee experience initiatives.
Supporting other operational or organizational projects as the company grows.




This role is primarily focused on recruiting, but as TopFoxx continues to grow, there may be opportunities to develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities in areas where you can make a meaningful impact.




What We're Looking For

Preferred:

Experience recruiting for roles such as:
E-commerce Shopify DTC Marketing
Paid Media
Creative Strategy
Video Editing
Email Marketing
SMS Marketing
Affiliate Marketing
Influencer Marketing
Wholesale Sales

Experience working with remote international teams is a strong plus.




Must-haves:

2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.
Experience recruiting digital marketing, creative, e-commerce, or startup positions.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills.
Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously.
Exceptional organization and follow-through.
Strong ownership mindset, you proactively solve problems instead of waiting for direction.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Must have a growth mindset, developing your skills and solving hardest problems. 




Nice to have:

LinkedIn Recruiter
Indeed
OnlineJobs.ph
Google Workspace
Asana
AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude
Startup or e-commerce experience
Experience building recruiting scorecards, interview guides, assessments, or hiring SOPs




What You Get:

$800 to $1,300 USD per month plus performance bonuses based on experience.
Fully remote role with flexible hours around 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern.
Direct collaboration with leadership and the Founder.
Significant opportunities for career growth as TopFoxx continues to scale.
A supportive, ambitious, and collaborative team environment.
Free TopFoxx products.
Paid time off.




How to Apply:

Send us your resume to recruiting@topfoxx.com along with a short response answering the following question: Tell us about the most difficult role you've ever recruited for. What made it challenging, how did you approach the search, and what was the final outcome?




We'd also love to know why recruiting marketing and creative talent excites you, and what you think separates an exceptional candidate from an average one.




If you're passionate about building outstanding teams and helping a growing company find incredible people, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Being part of the Driver Growth Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to build and optimize the supply engine of the leading mobility platform. In this role, you will help transform Driver Management into a high-impact, scalable supply capabilities model across Spanish-Speaking LatAm. Our team builds data-driven acquisition and engagement systems that structurally improve user lifecycles, boost lifetime value, and increase platform preference.

In this role, you'll be...

This role owns how deep our community programs can go in shaping the driver experience, and how many drivers get the chance to feel it. We believe deeply in what these programs create: a genuine sense of connection between drivers and the platform that goes beyond any single trip. Your job is to amplify that reach: identifying the right driver profile across our markets, and expanding the experience to more of our driver base through a deep understanding of driver needs that proves scalable growth. You'll be measured on how far that expansion reaches and how reliably it lands as we grow. It suits an operator who treats scaling something genuinely valuable as its own craft, not just a numbers exercise.


Driver profile & journey: Define what the ideal driver looks like in each market, and follow their path from invitation to getting started, so you can spot where interested drivers drop off.
Outreach execution ownership: Set the operating standard for the team that executes outreach at scale, and own their results end to end, leading through influence rather than direct authority.
Expansion planning: Decide where and when we expand next based on how ready each market is, and keep that expansion moving at a fast, confident pace.
Analytics & reporting: Own the reporting that shows how the program is performing across the region, and translate it into concrete recommendations for program design.
Field insight & product input: Spend real time with drivers and local teams in-market, and turn what you learn into direct product improvements that shape the driver experience.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


3+ years of professional experience in operations, growth, or analytics roles, with demonstrated independent ownership of end-to-end projects.
Prior experience with user communities, marketplace operations, or gig-economy platforms is a strong plus.
Advanced analytical skills, including spreadsheets, data automation, modeling, and database manipulation. SQL is a must, used independently and daily to pull and validate your own data.
Experience taking full ownership of a BPO's operational outcomes, holding them to a high bar on quality, results, and deadlines.
A/B testing experience is a must, along with turning user research (interviews, focus groups, sampling) into concrete program or product recommendations, with working familiarity with basic statistical concepts such as significance testing.
Passion for using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to speed up analysis, reporting, and structured thinking. Hands-on experience building automations, prompts, or small AI-powered workflows is highly desired.
Fluency in Spanish and professional working English.
Strong organizational skills: you can track multiple moving parts across markets without dropping a thread.
Availability to travel approximately 30% of the time, including in-market presence during market expansion and periodic in-field visits.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. About the job

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:


Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.

Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

title: Digital Marketing Analyst
description:
About the job

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

NEOGEN Digital Marketing Analyst support our LATAM digital marketing team. The responsibilities will include social media management for our LATAM accounts, it is Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram; execute campaign strategies and create marketing digital assets as email templates, forms, and landing pages on Eloqua (marketing automation), SEO, website optimization and maintenance. This role will also be responsible for assign new leads to sales representant on Salesforce CRM; collect and analyze data from social media, google and Eloqua for digital reports.

The Marketing Automation Specialist is responsible for creating and developing content for forms, landing pages, and email templates within Eloqua, supporting website design, development, and planning, and executing marketing campaigns across multiple digital channels. This role manages lead generation and lead routing processes, supports content ecosystem administration through platforms such as Bynder and Seismic, and monitors marketing KPIs and campaign performance to optimize results.

The position requires maintaining consistency and compliance with brand guidelines, messaging, and approved materials, using only content validated by marketing, technical, and legal stakeholders to ensure traceability and compliance. The incumbent is also responsible for keeping Quality Management System (QMS) documentation up to date, contributing to preventive actions and continuous process improvements, and maintaining an organized and compliant work environment.

In alignment with Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards, the employee is expected to use all applicable personal and collective protective equipment, maintain an appropriate workstation, take active breaks, and manage workloads to support personal health and performance.

The successful candidate demonstrates and embodies Neogen's Pillars of Trust—Openness, Honesty, Credibility, Respect, and Service—through all actions, behaviors, and communications. They communicate effectively, actively listen, lead by example, foster teamwork and trust, make timely decisions, solve problems efficiently, and drive performance through accountability, productivity, and innovation. They also understand their role within the broader organization and remain curious about how their work contributes to business success.

Qualifications include a college degree, preferably a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, with at least one year of relevant experience (two years preferred). Candidates should possess knowledge of marketing principles, Microsoft Office applications, CRM systems, and marketing automation platforms, with experience in Eloqua and Salesforce preferred. Additional expertise in digital marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, UX/UI design, SEO, SEM, marketing analytics, business intelligence tools, and reporting is highly desirable. An intermediate to advanced level of English is required.

Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

About the job

Being part of the Driver Growth Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. This data driven role calls for a rare combination of user-centric, analytical thinking & interpersonal ability. You will have the opportunity to work in a tight team, where you will launch, build and run DiDi's business in Spanish Speaking LatAm. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

Driver Growth Operations team members are very important for the expansion and sustainability of the business. The ideal candidates for our opening roles should have very strong analytical skills (e.g. Python, R, SQL, etc.) and feel comfortable transforming insights into business decisions.

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi growth in LATAM!

In this role, you'll be...

Design and implement initiatives to acquire new drivers, being able to leverage data for the decision making process.
Manage the launch and execution of incentives, projects, communications and product developments needed for driver acquisition, ensuring efficiency and expansion.
Be primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, managing expectations and prioritizing operations to deliver results, whilst constantly working along cross-functional teams (Marketing, Legal, City Operations, Product, etc).
Define and manage data dashboards to monitor national performance of driver acquisition and our results.
Ownership of driver acquisition incentives, across multiple countries in Spanish Speaking LatAm.
Constantly generate knowledge through experimental testing.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The successful applicant:


Bachelor's Degree: Engineering, Data Science, Actuary or any related field.
Growth / Marketplace experience: Experimental Testing, User Acquisition, Conversion, Habit Loops, PMF, GTM, Communication Strategies, Marketplace Balance, Pricing, etc

Effective communication skills. Proficiency in English & Spanish. We're an international team!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

Job Description

Join Drive the Future Program in Mexico if you are a student in your last 2 years of University. This is a part-time role in which you will receive several trainings & coaching to develop professional skills while experiencing our inclusive culture led by our principles: Service, Hearth, Curiosity, Courage and Excellence.

JPMorgan&Chase is seeking exceptional individuals to join our team in various roles across Technology. This is your chance to gain invaluable experience and contribute to our world-class investment banking operations.

We have been doing business in Mexico for more than 125 years. We combine our global resources with local expertise to serve clients through divisions like Investment Banking, Wholesale Payments, Markets, and Asset & Wealth Management. Communities and clients across the region rely on our industry-leading products and services to meet their business needs now and in the future. Be part of a dynamic team that provides creative solutions to help individuals, companies, institutions and governments solve their financial and business challenges.

During journey in our program, you'll collaborate with our expert professionals to influence and shape decisions and initiatives that support our businesses across the firm. You'll have the opportunity to make meaningful contributions while developing your professional expertise in a dynamic team environment.

Part-time availability (30hs per week)
Availability to work in Ciudad de Mexico, Mexico
Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.

After you click ‘Apply', the first step is to fully complete your application.

About the job

Sobre nosotros:

En Grupo Editorial Tirant lo Blanch nos enorgullece ofrecer un entorno dinámico y estimulante, donde cada miembro del equipo desempeña un papel vital en el éxito de nuestros proyectos.

Valoramos la experiencia, la dedicación y fomentamos el crecimiento profesional y la innovación.

 

Responsabilidades

El responsable de Tirant Formación dirige el departamento de Formación en México. Esto supone el diseño, implementación y evaluación de los programas de capacitación jurídica que imparte Tirant. En Tirant Formación se imparten programas como: cursos en línea (tipo diplomado), seminarios, programas con RVOE y formación presencial boutique.

 

 Las tareas a realizar, entre otras, serán:

Diseño de los programas de Tirant Formación. Lanzamiento y evaluación de los mismos.
Interlocución con los profesores y directores de los programas.
Coordinación con otros departamentos de la empresa como comercial y marketing.

Se apreciará la profesionalidad de la persona candidata, sus ganas de aprender y adaptabilidad. Asimismo, serán valoradas sus habilidades interpersonales y su capacidad de trabajar bajo presión y con objetivos medibles.

 

Este puesto tiene dependencia directa de la dirección de Tirant México y de la dirección internacional de Tirant Formación.




Requisitos mínimos:

Formación en Derecho.
Al menos 3 años de experiencia profesional, con especial énfasis en organización de eventos formativos.

As a Product Analyst, you will be supporting the growth, engagement, and commercial success of SportyBet in Mexico by delivering high-quality analysis, market intelligence, and actionable insights. title: Performance & Growth Marketing Manager
description:
About the job

Buscamos a una persona que quiera tomar ownership de ese reto: diseñar, ejecutar y optimizar la estrategia de growth de principio a fin. Este rol no es de coordinación: es un rol altamente hands-on, orientado a resultados y con impacto directo en el revenue de la compañía.




Responsabilidades




Gestión del Canal Web

• Diseñar e implementar la estrategia para incrementar la venta directa en el sitio web.

• Optimizar el funnel de conversión — desde tráfico hasta reserva confirmada.

• Colaborar con los equipos de diseño para optimizar la experiencia UX/UI.

• Monitorear disponibilidad, rendimiento y experiencia del sitio de forma continua.




Campañas de Marketing Digital

• Diseñar y ejecutar campañas de Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok, etc.) con foco en CAC, revenue, reservas y ROAS.

• Gestionar y ejecutar la estrategia de Email Marketing y automatizaciones.

• Liderar la estrategia SEO orgánica para incrementar la participación del canal en el revenue del canal web.

• Supervisar redes sociales alineadas a los objetivos de conversión.

• Gestionar agencias y proveedores externos asegurando ejecución y resultados.




Analítica y Performance

• Construir y mantener dashboards de desempeño con métricas de negocio.

• Traducir datos en decisiones: optimización de campañas, canales y presupuesto.

• Reportar resultados periódicamente a dirección con foco en impacto y siguientes pasos.

• Diseñar y ejecutar experimentos A/B para mejora continua del canal.

• Optimizar etiquetas GTM para mejorar la medición digital.




Recurrencia, Retención y CRM

• Liderar y diseñar la estrategia de recurrencia de ULIV.

• Optimizar el CRM de ULIV en HubSpot.




Marketing dentro de OTAs (Booking.com y Expedia)

• Diseñar y optimizar estrategias de visibilidad pagada dentro de plataformas como Booking.com y Expedia (Sponsored Listings, TravelAds, Accelerator, Visibility Booster y herramientas equivalentes).

• Monitorear el retorno incremental de campañas dentro de OTAs versus crecimiento orgánico.

• Trabajar de la mano con Revenue Management para balancear ocupación, ADR, mix de canal y rentabilidad.

• Definir criterios de inversión por propiedad, mercado, temporada y demanda.




Colaboración Transversal

• Trabajar de cerca con Revenue Management y ventas para crear estrategias en conjunto.

• Alinear la estrategia de marketing con disponibilidad de inventario y pricing.

• Contribuir a la definición de la propuesta de valor y posicionamiento de ULIV.




Requisitos

Experiencia y Formación

• Licenciatura en Marketing, Administración, Comunicación o carrera afín.

• 4 a 6 años de experiencia en Growth Marketing y/o marketing digital.

• Experiencia comprobable gestionando presupuesto de paid media y entregando resultados.

• Experiencia en e-commerce o industrias orientadas a conversión es un plus.




Habilidades Técnicas

• Google Ads avanzado (Search, PMAX, Display, Remarketing)

• Meta Ads

• Google Analytics 4

• Google Tag Manager

• CRO

• CRM / Lifecycle Marketing

• Funnel optimization

• SQL básico o alta capacidad analítica




Lo que ofrecemos

• Sueldo competitivo acorde al perfil y experiencia ($45,000 Netos)

• Prestaciones superiores a las de ley.

• Impacto directo y visible en el negocio desde el primer mes.

• Ambiente de trabajo dinámico, con autonomía y confianza.

• Crecimiento profesional real en una empresa en expansión.

description:
About the job

About Us

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, delivering news, research, and global events that power smarter decisions across the industry. We convene senior leaders and innovators who rely on Skift for clarity, insight, and meaningful connection in a fast-moving global market.




The Opportunity

We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Advertising Sales Coordinator to join Skift and drive the day-to-day execution of our sales operations. This role is ideal for an operational professional who thrives on owning repeatable processes and ensuring digital systems run flawlessly. You will take charge of contracts, CRM data, lead management, and pipeline support, building a deep familiarity with Skift's sales engine. If you are a proactive problem-solver looking for a role with a clear path toward greater ownership over time, this is your moment. We are looking for candidates based in LATAM.




Why This Role Matters

Reporting to the Sales Operations Manager, you are the operational backbone of Skift’s Branded Sales team. By owning the day-to-day execution of contracts, lead management, and CRM administration, you free up leadership to focus on high-level strategy, systems, and cross-functional governance. Working closely with Sales, Studio, Product, and Finance, your meticulous attention to detail ensures that our commercial engine runs smoothly, discrepancies are caught early, and revenue is tracked accurately.




Some of What You’ll Do

Contract Administration & Deal Execution

Generate standard sponsorship agreements, insertion orders, and order forms using approved templates, ensuring all information is complete and consistent.
Manage the full signature routing process, follow up on outstanding agreements, and ensure executed documents are properly saved in the contract repository.
Update deal status across HubSpot, Actuals, and prospect trackers, proactively escalating redlines or complex nonstandard terms to the Sales Operations Manager.

CRM & Lead Management

Maintain impeccable data hygiene in HubSpot by completing routine updates, data cleanup, deduplication, and quality checks.
Review and vet inbound leads, assign them to the appropriate sales representatives, and maintain trackers to monitor response status and conversion rates.
Flag high-value, unclear, or suspicious inquiries, and assist with targeted prospect and audience list development.

Pipeline & Digital Campaign Support

Reconcile routine discrepancies between contracts, HubSpot, and internal trackers, actively monitoring deals as they move from verbal agreement to closed-won.
Prepare accurate data for monthly revenue reconciliation, recurring pacing, and campaign reports.
Support digital campaign execution by assisting with creative collection, quality assurance, and proof-of-performance reporting for newsletter and podcast sponsorships.

Process Documentation & Cross-Team Coordination

Document recurring workflows, update instructions as processes evolve, and support the onboarding of new team members.
Coordinate routine operational requests across Sales, Studio, and Finance, constantly identifying repetitive tasks or process gaps that can be improved.




What You’ll Bring

1–3 years of experience in sales coordination, sales operations, or a similar administrative support role.
CRM Fluency: Hands-on experience working in a CRM (HubSpot is highly preferred), with a strong grasp of data cleanup, pipeline management, and lead routing.
Operational Rigor: Exceptional attention to detail and strong spreadsheet skills, allowing you to manage multiple deadlines, complex workflows, and detail-heavy business records simultaneously.
Proactive Communication: Clear written and professional follow-up skills. You are comfortable communicating with clients, recognize when to escalate an issue, and never let details paralyze your execution.
Adaptability: A calm demeanor when priorities shift, a receptiveness to feedback, and the ability to learn systems quickly in a remote work environment.
Bonus: Experience with PandaDoc (or similar e-signature platforms), familiarity with commercial tools (Apollo, Basecamp), or prior exposure to sponsored content, media, and digital advertising.




Success Metrics

Operational Accuracy: Contracts, CRM updates, and lead management are handled accurately, on time, and with pristine attention to detail.
Process Autonomy: Reliable, independent execution of daily sales ops tasks and workflows within the first 6–12 months.
Proactive Problem Solving: Errors, discrepancies, and missing data are caught early and escalated appropriately before they impact the pipeline or billing.
Seamless Collaboration: The establishment of strong, trusted working relationships across the Sales, Studio, Product, and Finance teams.




What We Offer

Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company.
Exposure to the intersection of media, events, and travel intelligence.
Collaborative, supportive, and remote-friendly work environment.




How We Work

Skift's culture is diverse, cohesive, and full of people who love what they do and bring the best of themselves to work. We are remote but very connected and caring about each other.




How To Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. PLEASE SEND US A COVER LETTER ALONG WITH YOUR RESUME sharing why you’re interested and how your experience aligns with Skift's mission.

Skift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of travelers around the world. We welcome applicants from all life experiences and encourage members of traditionally underrepresented backgrounds to apply.




Here’s what you can expect next

If selected to interview, a Skift team member will reach out to schedule next steps.

title: Sr Data Scientist
skills: Own delivery of one or more core workstreams — bill data extraction, forecasting, or audit/anomaly detection — and flex across them with your manager as priorities shift.
Build, evaluate, and improve production models: document classifiers and extraction agents, forecasting models for bill availability and spend, and detection and tuning for audits and controls.
Set the technical approach on problems where the right method isn't established — investigate, decide, and carry the recommendation through to a shipped result.
Partner with the Director on prioritization and sequencing across workstreams, bringing a point of view on where the team should invest rather than only the capacity to execute.
Write production-grade Python and contribute to the shared codebase, pipelines, and design docs — this is a live production system, not a notebook sandbox.
Partner with engineering on model integration, monitoring, and post-deployment behavior – as the authority on the modeling approach and the team's resource for applying AI in production.
Automate manual steps in your own and the team's workflow with AI tooling, and share the techniques that raise throughput.

Substantial hands-on experience building and evaluating production ML models, with the judgment to make progress on ambiguous problems independently. The right person will need at least 3 years of experience working in ML models.
Strong ML fundamentals — statistics, classification, regression, and evaluation methodology.
Fluency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, numpy) and SQL, and comfort working in a live production codebase not just notebooks.
Practical experience with LLMs or agentic workflows in production.
Comfort with imperfect ground truth and managing inherent uncertainty in data.
A track record of driving work with minimal oversight: forming and documenting assumptions, making the call on approach, and standing behind a recommendation.
Clear communication that adapts to the audience: able to explain model behavior to engineers and non-technical partners and make the case for a decision.
Bachelor's or Master's in CS, Statistics, Math, or a related field (or equivalent experience), plus a portfolio of past work — GitHub, papers, or project write-ups. What We're Not Looking For
A pure research role, an NLP/LLM research specialist, or a data analytics/BI role.
Someone whose experience is mainly dashboarding, reporting, or model-free data work.
Someone who needs close day-to-day direction — this role runs with real autonomy. *This job posting exists to fill a vacancy.

About the job

What is Cobre and what do we do?

Cobre is Latin America’s leading instant b2b payments platform. We solve the region’s most complex money movement challenges by building advanced financial infrastructure that enables companies to move money faster, safer, and more efficiently.

We enable instant business payments—local or international, direct or via API—all from a single platform.

Built for fintechs, PSPs, banks, and finance teams that demand speed, control, and efficiency. From real-time payments to automated treasury, we turn complex financial processes into simple experiences.

Cobre is the first platform in Colombia to enable companies to pay both banked and unbanked beneficiaries within the same payment cycle and through a single interface.

We are building the enterprise payments infrastructure of Latin America!







What we are looking for:

As a Customer Success Specialist, you will be responsible for providing support to users and/or corporate clients through the main customer service contact channels, delivering the requested information and offering assistance related to our products. You will also maintain constant communication with the leader to ensure proper alignment of objectives.




What would you be doing:

Collaborate with the Customer Experience team to identify and resolve issues affecting customers.
Use tools and technologies to analyze data and enhance the customer experience.
Support new features and improvements in our systems.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes and technological tools.
Act as the single point of resolution for the assigned customer and serve as an intermediary between the KAM, the customer, operations, and technology.
Conduct in-depth analysis of customer needs and preferences.
Provide continuous follow-up and swift issue resolution.
Document all interactions to personalize future communications.
Understand and map out the companies' touchpoints.




What do you need:

Previous experience in roles related to customer experience improvement and management.
Basic knowledge of programming.
Experience in SQL for database management and manipulation.
Experience with Postman for API testing.
Familiarity with New Relic for application monitoring.
Knowledge of Simetrik and Snowflake.
Preferably with experience in fintech, technology companies, and/or payments.
Excellent teamwork skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with different teams and areas within the company.

title: Colaborador de Atencion a Clientes (5 dias a la semana, Contrato temporal)
skills: Valorar y satisfacer las necesidades y expectativas de los clientes, incentivando visitas cada vez más frecuentes.

Tengo los conocimientos, la confianza y el deseo de resolver las quejas de los clientes. Trato de forma positiva y rápida cualquier problema que se presente.
Tengo los conocimientos, la confianza y el deseo de facilitar al máximo el proceso de compra de nuestros clientes.

Me aseguro de escuchar a nuestros clientes y de utilizar mis conocimientos tanto de la gama de productos IKEA como del funcionamiento del comercio minorista (retail) para ofrecer soluciones informadas y resolver los problemas de los clientes.

Estoy facultado para resolver las quejas de los clientes en la medida de mi nivel de autorización. Sé cuándo debo escalar un problema y transmitir la información pertinente a un gerente para tratar eficazmente con el cliente.

Sé armar los productos de IKEA y puedo ayudar a los clientes que tengan dificultades en el armado. También reemplazo componentes cuando es necesario y ofrezco soluciones a preguntas frecuentes. Esto contribuye a mejorar la futura experiencia de compra de todos.
Registro la información con precisión en los sistemas pertinentes para que el análisis resultante nos permita incorporar mejoras a las futuras experiencias de compra de nuestros clientes.
Me aseguro de que la tienda IKEA sea un entorno seguro para visitantes y colaboradores.
Asegurándome de conocer la gama de productos y servicios de IKEA y trabajando activamente para ofrecer soluciones alternativas que satisfagan las necesidades de cada cliente.

Entendiendo el concepto IKEA, las soluciones globales, las herramientas y los métodos de trabajo, y asegurándome de utilizar los manuales adecuados de Inter IKEA Systems para optimizar la experiencia de compra de nuestros clientes.

Transmito mis conocimientos a los colaboradores y los animo a hacer lo mismo.
Me mantengo informado para poder actuar con eficacia.

About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.

To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to support and drive our Customer Success teams regionally. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.

We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.

Location: These opportunities are available in the APAC and AMER regions and are remote positions.

The role entails:


Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You will develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive up-sells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
Customer interactions and support to your team: resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention ensuring timely resolution.
Team management: passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. 
Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.



What We Are Looking For In You


Excellent academic results at school and university
Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject
Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
Experience growing and developing a CSM team
Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events



Nice-to-have Skills


Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.



What We Offer You

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.


Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Customer Quality Specialist
skills: Supporting specific communication relevant to quality management in your area of responsibility.
Assisting in continuously identifying and addressing risks and opportunities related to quality management in the local organization.
Using quality data analytics from the organization to identify risks, failures, and non-conformances.
Facilitating resolution of customer cases by following a robust root cause analysis and implementing preventive and corrective actions.
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, industrial or related.
4+ Year experience in Customer Quality, Manufacturing Quality, manufacturing process and Continuous Improvement in a manufacturing environment.
Plus working as a quality engineer with switchboards, motor control centers, or low-voltage electrification systems.
Experience in SAP, Microsoft Office, Power BI, and structured problem-solving documentation tools such as 8D reports, A3, Ishikawa diagrams, 5 Why analysis, and corrective action tracking systems.

Advanced English.
description:
About the job

En ABB, ayudamos a las industrias a funcionar de forma más eficiente y limpia, y cada una de las personas que trabajan aquí lo hace posible. Estarás capacitado para liderar, apoyado para crecer y orgulloso del impacto que creamos juntos. Únete a nosotros y ayuda a que funcione lo que hace funcionar el mundo.

Este Puesto Reporta a

Customer Quality Engineer

__

Your Role And Responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the deployment of the quality strategy for a local organizational unit, including quality culture, systems, tools, and competent teams with the aim to achieve and exceed customer expectations, while ensuring sustainable operations. Each day, you will assist the organization in achieving the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. You will also showcase your expertise by collaborating with local functions that impact the quality results to reach the targets for the organizational unit and aim for world-class performance.

The Work Model For The Role Is

This role is contributing to the Electrification Business in Apodaca, Nuevo Leon.

You Will Be Mainly Accountable For


Supporting specific communication relevant to quality management in your area of responsibility.
Assisting in continuously identifying and addressing risks and opportunities related to quality management in the local organization.
Using quality data analytics from the organization to identify risks, failures, and non-conformances.
Facilitating resolution of customer cases by following a robust root cause analysis and implementing preventive and corrective actions.


Qualifications For The Role (Mandatory)


Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, industrial or related. 
4+ Year experience in Customer Quality, Manufacturing Quality, manufacturing process and Continuous Improvement in a manufacturing environment. 
Plus working as a quality engineer with switchboards, motor control centers, or low-voltage electrification systems. 
Experience in SAP, Microsoft Office, Power BI, and structured problem-solving documentation tools such as 8D reports, A3, Ishikawa diagrams, 5 Why analysis, and corrective action tracking systems. 
Experience in Lean Six Sigma. (Green Belt Certification is a plus). 
Advanced English.


Construir un futuro más limpio e inteligente requiere todo tipo de mentes: las curiosas, las valientes y las creativas. Por eso acogemos a personas de todos los orígenes y experiencias.

¿Listo para causar impacto?

Presenta tu candidatura hoy mismo o visita https://www.abb.com para saber más sobre el impacto de nuestras soluciones en todo el mundo.

description:
About the job

Responsibilities
About the team:
At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time 

About the role:
TikTok is seeking Agency Solutions Managers to support our strategic Holdco agency partners and be based out of the Mexico City office. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in digital advertising and a proven ability to drive both operational excellence and commercial growth to unlock new business. The candidate will have operational knowledge of agency dynamics and experience dealing with key stakeholders across media planning, programmatic trading, and digital buying teams. A proven track record in scaling client investment and elevating campaign performance is a must.

Above all, the candidate will have an established track record of building strong relationships across key stakeholders, acting as a dedicated in-house expert and a bridge between the agency and TikTok. The role will involve working cross-functionally with members of the TikTok sales, product, and support organizations with the intent of leading end-to-end client engagement, from technical troubleshooting and campaign activation to education and strategic upselling. You’ll bring a creative mindset, detail-oriented focus, and strategic acumen in your approach to identifying new business opportunities, accelerating product adoption, and building long-term business partnerships.

Responsibilities:
- Identify and drive revenue opportunities: Act as an in-house expert within strategic Holdco agencies to capture new opportunities, seek out strategic partnerships, and proactively hunt for new client briefs to expand the business portfolio. 
- Provide consultative support and elevate trader proficiency: Offer strategic media solutions and campaign optimization guidance, while designing and leading ongoing training sessions to improve media buyer expertise and optimize campaign delivery rates. 
- Deliver strategic insights and execute upselling: Analyze platform data to provide proactive audience targeting recommendations, while creating compelling post-sale propositions to actively recommend premium supply and diverse ad formats. 
- Lead technical troubleshooting: Act as the primary technical liaison for the agency to swiftly resolve campaign delivery issues and creative moderation escalations. 
- Drive product adoption: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to structure and execute operational initiatives focused on accelerating new feature adoption, beta support, and API integrations. 
- Streamline campaign activation: Remove operational friction during the setup and launch phases to ensure the seamless activation of new advertisers. 
- Ensure customer success: Deliver the highest level of sales and operational customer service, providing agile, on-demand support for specialized client requests while keeping clients informed of the latest platform products and developments.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Years of digital advertising and client-facing roles experience.
- Years of Ad Agency experience or similar role.
- Expert knowledge of social media, mobile apps, and digital and mobile marketing.
- Proven experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers and formulate enablement recommendations.
- Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills with the ability to establish credibility with technical and non-technical business owners with advanced English skills.
- Strong ability to own relationships with programmatic trading desk managers and engage with multiple customer organizational levels to understand business objectives and a team player and collaborator.
- Knowledge of the self-serve platform, auction, and biddable form of digital advertising buying.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in e-commerce, omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing, or online advertising.
- Familiarity with advertising APIs, measurement pixels, and advanced performance marketing metrics.
- Proven track record of reaching and exceeding sales goals and winning the support of key stakeholders.
- Ability to perform well in a rapidly changing environment.
- Passion for TikTok marketing, and up for the challenge of building something from the bottom up.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone.

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

About The Role

This is first and foremost an analysis and strategy role, and it sits on top of one of the most important conversion channels we have. You own the thinking behind the account: what to test, what to cut, and how to push toward the leads most likely to become customers. Because paid search drives so much of our inbound pipeline, this is a high-visibility, high-impact seat, and what you decide here shows up directly in the numbers the business watches.

Day-to-day execution largely sits with our paid marketing agency, so a big part of the job is coordinating them well: setting priorities, briefing the work, reviewing what they ship, and holding the bar on quality and pace. It is not a hands-off role, though. You should be ready to get into the account yourself when a change needs to move fast or be done right. The mission is clear: use lower-funnel conversion signals to bring in better, higher-quality leads.

You will work directly with the performance marketing lead and move fast. We lean on AI tools to work smarter, so expect them to be part of how you do the job every day.

What You'll Do


Own the analysis and strategy for the Google Ads program: what to test, what to scale, and what to cut.
Raise the account's Quality Score by improving ad relevance and landing page experience.
Own conversion tracking and feed the account lower-funnel signals, so it optimizes toward high-quality leads and not just form fills.
Coordinate our paid marketing agency: set priorities, brief the work, review what they ship, and hold the bar on quality and pace.
Dig into the data (search terms, Quality Score, lead quality) to separate what works from what is waste, and turn it into a clear plan.
Get hands-on in the account when needed: restructure ad groups, add negatives, adjust bids, fix tracking.
Use AI tools like Claude to work faster and sharper: structure and analyze data, pressure-test your hypotheses, and move from insight to decision in less time. The judgment stays yours; the tools just let you cover more ground.
Run a continuous testing agenda and report performance clearly: what changed, what it moved, and what is next.


What Success Looks Like


Within your first few months, Quality Score is trending up and high-quality leads are a bigger share of the mix.
The agency runs smoothly under you: clear priorities, fast turnarounds, and work that meets your bar.
Your reporting is the source of truth the team trusts to decide where paid search goes next.


What We Are Looking For


2+ years of hands-on Google Ads / paid search, ideally in lead generation, with results you can point to.
Advanced, near-native English, written and spoken. You will write ad copy and reports for a US audience.
Real fluency with the Google Ads account structure: match types, Smart Bidding, conversion actions, and search-terms analysis.
You are comfortable with data: you pull the numbers, read them, and turn them into a decision without hand-holding.
Strong spreadsheet skills, non-negotiable. We work in Google Sheets, and if you are not fluent with pivot tables, conditional functions, and lookups (VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP), this is not the role for you.
A bias for action and strong ownership. You move fast, document your work, and do not need to be chased.
Clear communication. You can explain a tradeoff to someone who does not live in the account.


Nice to have


Performance Max and broader Google campaign types.
Solid GA4, including conversion tracking setup and QA.
Building or iterating landing pages (we use Lovable) and improving conversion rate with tools like Microsoft Clarity.
Familiarity with B2B marketing.
Basic SQL or a data background, a plus and not a requirement.


Tools you will use 

Google Ads, GA4, Google Sheets, Lovable for landing pages, Microsoft Clarity, and Claude for scaled execution.

Why join us 


Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery. 
Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.


What Else You Need To Know

This role is based in our Mexico CIty office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

title: Senior Director, Agentic Managed Services
description:
About the job

Senior Director, Agentic Managed Services




Who You’ll Work With

Slalom’s Agentic Managed Services (AMS) team is an innovative team pushing the bounds of what is next at Slalom. AMS is Slalom’s managed services business for creating and operating AI agents in production as a governed, measurable service, with renewable contracts, repeatable delivery, and verified client outcomes.




As Senior Director, Managed Services, you are the operational leader of the AMS Latin America (LATAM) delivery team. You will build, hire, and run the team responsible for executing day-to-day managed services delivery across active client engagements. You own the people, the profitability, and the delivery quality of this team, reporting directly to Managing Director, Managed Services, who sets strategy and is accountable for the overall success.




You will enjoy this role if you are energized by building high-performing delivery teams from the ground up, you know what excellent managed services operations look like, and you are ready to own execution, not just contribute to it. You thrive in fast-moving, high-accountability environments, take personal ownership of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and know how to develop talent into career-defining professionals. You want to be part of the cutting edge of managed services with AI agents, rethinking how traditional managed services are delivered from a LATAM delivery hub.




What You’ll Do

Team Build-Out & Staffing

Recruit, hire, and develop the LATAM managed services delivery team that staffs and supports active client engagements globally, with a focus on North America

Design and maintain the team structure: roles, spans, coverage tiers, and scheduling that enables the LATAM team to operate reliably across client time zones

Build and lead a team sized for agent-first operations, this is a lean, high-judgment workforce designed to supervise agents, manage exceptions, and drive continuous improvement at scale, not a traditional headcount-intensive managed services model

Build the talent pipeline for delivery professionals in LATAM; create the progression model that attracts and retains top operational talent

Partner with recruiting and HR to maintain a healthy pipeline of candidates and uphold hiring standards




Delivery Execution & Quality

Own day-to-day delivery quality across all AMS engagements staffed by the LATAM team; ensure SLA attainment, client satisfaction, and performance against contracted outcomes

Operate the agent-first delivery model in practice: your team is the human oversight layer, handling exceptions that agents escalate, reviewing automated performance outputs, validating model behavior against contracted KPIs, and executing continuous improvement based on what the observability stack surfaces

Serve as the operational escalation point for the LATAM team; triage and resolve delivery issues, lead incident response when needed, and ensure every resolution becomes institutional knowledge that improves future agent and human response

Define and enforce what ‘production-ready’ means for LATAM-delivered engagements; partner with the Managing Director to maintain consistency with global delivery standards

Build and maintain the runbooks, standard operating procedures, and escalation paths that make LATAM delivery consistent and repeatable at scale

Oversee agent performance monitoring, model drift detection, and routine operational health checks across active client engagements supported by your team




Financial Performance & Unit Economics

Work with the Managing Director and commercial strategy team to ensure staffing models and coverage assumptions are reflected accurately in deal economics before contracts are signed

Identify and act on opportunities to reduce the human-to-client ratio through tooling, process maturity, and agent expansion, improving unit economics without compromising SLA attainment or quality




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with engineering leadership to understand and influence the agent-first delivery roadmap; serve as the voice of the delivery team as runbooks mature and automation expands into operations

Work closely with the Managing Director to align on operating model decisions, escalate systemic delivery issues, and contribute to the overall AMS strategy for the LATAM delivery function

Document best practices, calibrate quality standards, and maintain a consistent client experience across geographies

Support client governance and reporting obligations: contribute to SLA dashboards, audit logs, and outcome-linked performance summaries that demonstrate value to clients




What You’ll Bring

15+ years of experience, including 8+ years building or leading managed services, BPO operations, or outsourced business process delivery teams. You have run a delivery operation before, not just participated in one

A track record of operating SLA-based services at scale: you have owned uptime and performance commitments for a multi-client portfolio, managed incident response, and driven client retention through operational excellence

Demonstrated experience hiring, developing, and leading delivery teams; you know how to build structure and quality frameworks that make remote delivery consistent and client-ready

Strong financial acumen: you have set staffing-level assumptions and tracked the unit economics that determine whether a delivery team is healthy or heading toward margin compression

Familiarity with AI, automation, or intelligent workflow operations, you understand what makes production AI systems fail, how clients think about AI-powered services versus traditional staffing models

Working knowledge of AI operations concepts, model drift, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, observability, sufficient to set delivery standards and engage credibly with engineering teams

A builder’s instinct, you make decisions with incomplete information, create structure where none exists, and are energized by the challenge of standing something up from scratch

Strong operational leadership presence: you are credible with your team and with client operational stakeholders; you communicate clearly, hold teams accountable with fairness, and model the standards you set

Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken, required for this role; you will operate across both languages daily, including in client-facing and executive contexts




In addition, Employee acknowledges that they are fluent in English and that they understand the contents of this Exhibit.




About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.




What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.



Desired Skills and Experience

Accountability, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Business Process, Business Process Outsourcing, Continuous Improvement, Contracts, Cross-functional Collaboration, Customer Satisfaction, Engineering, English, Global Delivery, Governance, Incident Response, Leadership, Managed Services, Management, Observability, Operational Excellence, Performance Monitoring, Recruiting, Reporting, Service-Level Agreements, Spanish, Strategy
